llm_top3.reasoning: I deviate from the top quant ranks (TRMB, RPM, GGG) because their news is solid but incremental, and TRMB carries a $562M impairment and weak post-beat price action. WMB (rank 7) pairs a technical breakout and raised EBITDA target with a strategic $5.5B Haynesville/LNG capacity bet, PSX (rank 17) is at 52-week highs on record refining margins, a $10B buyback expansion and genuine global diesel tightness, and ROIV (rank 13) has the single most material catalyst in the list: FDA approval of LISRAYA, the first oral dermatomyositis therapy with $2B+ estimated US peak sales, where the share dip creates an entry.
